*** Amendment Three***

*** The purpose of this RFI amendment is to provide/post a Request for Information feedback loop to industry***
To provide/post a Request for Information feedback loop to industry reflecting a change in the acquisition strategy for this requirement. Accordingly the request for Quote will be changing from Service-Disabled  Veteran-Owned Small Business set-aside to unrestricted full and open competition.
